title: Summer and Garden
author: Wendell Brightwater
blurb: Oscar Eastwick, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must forgive the person in the mirror first before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
